Makes the sound of a movie come from an entity in the world, like [EmitSound](EmitSound): it gets quieter with distance and moves between the speakers. With [GetMovieTexture](GetMovieTexture) on a mesh this makes a screen in the world. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 640, 480, 0, 2
camera = CreateCamera()
CreateListener camera
movie  = OpenMovie("advert.mp4")
LoopMovie movie
screen = CreateCube()
PositionEntity screen, 0, 0, 10
ScaleEntity screen, 4, 2.25, 0.1
EntityTexture screen, GetMovieTexture(movie)
EmitMovie movie, screen
ChannelRadius MovieChannel(movie), 2 ; the screen is 4 units wide
```
@param movie  A movie handle from [OpenMovie](OpenMovie).
@param entity  The entity that the sound comes from, or `0` to play it on the speakers again.
@gap The sound of a movie gets no doppler shift: a change of pitch would play it faster or slower than the picture. [ChannelDoppler](ChannelDoppler) on it is ignored. A movie without sound, or without a sound device, ignores the command.
